sourceScope: The fixture mounts the production styleguide and registered real DMenubar examples from the exact source commit. The copied bundle only changes its Info.plist identity and ad-hoc signature; repository runner identities and entitlements are unchanged.

inspection.note: Earlier exact-source native passes inspected command/checkbox/radio/submenu/typeahead/Escape/Home/End behavior, dark/light/Plum, 360px/200% text, reduced motion, Arabic RTL and dark destructive icons. The 67aa23ab pass exposed remaining RTL anchor clipping and double-mirrored submenu chevrons. Source 430b46a0 fixes both; nested-Navigator regressions fail before and pass after. This rebuilt fixture is queued for focused native confirmation; it is not yet accepted.
